f3_program: collection("sit_ups.performed", "person_sit_up_total", "exercise", source("Barney does sit-ups for 1 minute, and Carrie does sit-ups for two minutes, and Jerrie does sit-ups for three minutes"))
observe(at("barney.sit_ups.rate", "current"), 45, "sit_up_per_minute", source("Barney can perform 45 sit-ups in one minute"))
multiple(at("carrie.sit_ups.rate", "current"), at("barney.sit_ups.rate", "current"), 2, source("Carrie can do twice as many sit-ups per minute as Barney can"))
offset(at("jerrie.sit_ups.rate", "current"), at("carrie.sit_ups.rate", "current"), 5, "sit_up_per_minute", source("Jerrie can do 5 more sit-ups per minute than Carrie can do"))
observe(at("barney.sit_ups.duration", "session"), 1, "minute", source("Barney does sit-ups for 1 minute"))
observe(at("carrie.sit_ups.duration", "session"), 2, "minute", source("Carrie does sit-ups for two minutes"))
observe(at("jerrie.sit_ups.duration", "session"), 3, "minute", source("Jerrie does sit-ups for three minutes"))
rate_relation("sit_ups.performed.barney.count", at("barney.sit_ups.rate", "current"), at("barney.sit_ups.duration", "session"), source("Barney does sit-ups for 1 minute"))
rate_relation("sit_ups.performed.carrie.count", at("carrie.sit_ups.rate", "current"), at("carrie.sit_ups.duration", "session"), source("Carrie does sit-ups for two minutes"))
rate_relation("sit_ups.performed.jerrie.count", at("jerrie.sit_ups.rate", "current"), at("jerrie.sit_ups.duration", "session"), source("Jerrie does sit-ups for three minutes"))
query("sum", "sit_ups.performed", "session")
assumptions: Each person's stated per-minute capacity applies throughout that person's specified exercise duration.

f3_program: observe(at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "initial"), 330, "count", source("Dr. Banks had 330 toothbrushes to give away to his patients"))
transfer("january_giveaway", "dr_banks", at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "current"), at("dr_banks.patients.toothbrushes.count", "current"), 53, source("He gave away 53 toothbrushes in January"))
transfer("february_giveaway", "dr_banks", at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "current"), at("dr_banks.patients.toothbrushes.count", "current"), 67, source("He gave away 67 toothbrushes in February"))
transfer("march_giveaway", "dr_banks", at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "current"), at("dr_banks.patients.toothbrushes.count", "current"), 46, source("In March he gave away 46 toothbrushes"))
same("dr_banks.toothbrushes.remaining_after_march.count", at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "current"), source("In April and May, he gave away the remaining toothbrushes, half each month"))
fraction_of("dr_banks.giveaways.april.quantity", "dr_banks.toothbrushes.remaining_after_march.count", 1, 2, source("In April and May, he gave away the remaining toothbrushes, half each month"))
fraction_of("dr_banks.giveaways.may.quantity", "dr_banks.toothbrushes.remaining_after_march.count", 1, 2, source("In April and May, he gave away the remaining toothbrushes, half each month"))

transfer("april_giveaway", "dr_banks", at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "current"), at("dr_banks.patients.toothbrushes.count", "current"), "dr_banks.giveaways.april.quantity", source("In April and May, he gave away the remaining toothbrushes, half each month"))

transfer("may_giveaway", "dr_banks", at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "current"), at("dr_banks.patients.toothbrushes.count", "current"), "dr_banks.giveaways.may.quantity", source("In April and May, he gave away the remaining toothbrushes, half each month"))

maximum_relation("dr_banks.giveaways.busiest.quantity", event_field("january_giveaway", "quantity"), event_field("february_giveaway", "quantity"), event_field("march_giveaway", "quantity"), event_field("april_giveaway", "quantity"), event_field("may_giveaway", "quantity"), source("busiest month"))

minimum_relation("dr_banks.giveaways.slowest.quantity", event_field("january_giveaway", "quantity"), event_field("february_giveaway", "quantity"), event_field("march_giveaway", "quantity"), event_field("april_giveaway", "quantity"), event_field("may_giveaway", "quantity"), source("slowest month"))
query("absolute_difference", "dr_banks.giveaways.busiest.quantity", "dr_banks.giveaways.slowest.quantity")
assumptions: The busiest and slowest months are selected from January through May, the months described in the source.

f3_program: observe(at("company.net_cash_provided_by_used_in_investing_activities", "2017"), -71, "million_currency", cell("Net cash provided by (used in) investing activities", "December 29, 2017"))
observe(at("company.net_cash_provided_by_used_in_investing_activities", "2018"), -114, "million_currency", cell("Net cash provided by (used in) investing activities", "December 28, 2018"))
query("difference", at("company.net_cash_provided_by_used_in_investing_activities", "2017"), at("company.net_cash_provided_by_used_in_investing_activities", "2018"))
assumptions: Parenthesized cash-flow figures are represented as negative values; the table states that figures are in millions.

f3_program: collection("oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days", "daily_earnings", "oliver.laundry_shop", source("How much did he earn for three days?"))
observe(at("oliver.laundry_shop.charge_rate", "current"), 2, "currency_per_kilogram", source("he charges $2 per kilo of laundry"))
observe(at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "two_days_ago"), 5, "kilogram", source("Two days ago, his shop washed a total of 5 kilos of laundries"))

offset(at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "yesterday"), at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "two_days_ago"), 5, "kilogram", source("Yesterday, it washed five kilos of laundries more than the previous day"))
multiple(at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "today"), at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "yesterday"), 2, source("Today, it washed twice the number of kilos than yesterday"))

rate_relation("oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days.two_days_ago", at("oliver.laundry_shop.charge_rate", "current"), at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "two_days_ago"), source("he charges $2 per kilo of laundry"))

rate_relation("oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days.yesterday", at("oliver.laundry_shop.charge_rate", "current"), at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "yesterday"), source("he charges $2 per kilo of laundry"))

rate_relation("oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days.today", at("oliver.laundry_shop.charge_rate", "current"), at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "today"), source("he charges $2 per kilo of laundry"))
query("sum", "oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days", "three_days")
assumptions: The stated per-kilogram charge applies to laundry washed on each of the three described days.

f3_program: collection("kelly.supplies", "school_supply", "kelly", source("Kelly needs school supplies"))
observe(at("kelly.class.students.count", "current"), 8, "count", source("She has 8 students"))
observe(at("kelly.supplies.construction_paper.per_student.count", "current"), 3, "piece_per_student", source("they will need 3 pieces of construction paper each"))

product_relation(at("kelly.supplies.construction_paper.count", "initial"), at("kelly.class.students.count", "current"), at("kelly.supplies.construction_paper.per_student.count", "current"), source("She has 8 students and they will need 3 pieces of construction paper each"))
observe(at("kelly.supplies.glue_bottles.count", "initial"), 6, "count", source("she needs to buy 6 bottles of glue"))
remove("storm_drain_drop", "kelly", at("kelly.supplies.count", "current"), fraction(at("kelly.supplies.count", "current"), 1, 2), source("she dropped half of them down a storm drain"))
add("additional_paper_purchase", "kelly", at("kelly.supplies.construction_paper.count", "current"), 5, source("she manages to rush to the store and buy 5 more pieces of construction paper"))
query("remaining_count", "kelly.supplies", "current")
assumptions: The initial supply state is the state immediately after Kelly purchases the planned paper and glue; "them" refers collectively to those supplies.
